text: George Street, between Adelaide Street East and Richmond Street East, is a local roadway which operates two-way north-south with a posted speed limit of 30 km/h. In the southbound direction, one traffic lane is provided and in the northbound direction, one traffic lane and one parking lane are provided. Residents of 105 George Street have raised concerns regarding vehicles parked on the north and south sides of the buildings driveway. The parked vehicles block the driveway, preventing access and cause visibility concerns for exiting motorists. To alleviate this issue, it is recommended to prohibit stopping on either side of the driveway for 105 George Street. Prohibiting stopping on the east side of George Street, adjacent to the driveway for 105 George Street, will prevent vehicles from parking in or occupying this area, ensuring driveway access and providing increased visibility to…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the east side of George Street, between a point 45.7 metres north of Adelaide Street East and a point 36.6 metres further north. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east side of George Street, between a point 49 metres north of Adelaide Street East and a point 27 metres further north.
